entries.original: A machine that cannot persist its telemetry stamp no longer reports itself active on every launch. The daily-active gate read the stamp, wrote it back, and decided from the read while swallowing any write failure, so an unwritable state directory reported a new active day indefinitely, and several processes starting at once on a fresh day each reported one. The decision is now the result of an exclusive file create, so exactly one caller per UTC day proceeds and an unwritable directory is capped at one report per process. Event names, properties and identity derivation are untouched, and a day already stamped still returns without writing anything. ([#8519](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8519))
entries.translated: 텔레메트리 스탬프를 유지할 수 없는 기기가 실행될 때마다 활성 상태로 보고되던 문제를 해결했습니다. 일일 활성 게이트가 스탬프를 읽고 다시 쓰는 과정에서 쓰기 실패를 무시했기 때문에, 쓰기 권한이 없는 상태 디렉토리가 새 활성일을 무한히 보고하거나 여러 프로세스가 동시에 시작될 때 각각 보고하는 문제가 있었습니다. 이제 배타적 파일 생성을 통해 결정되므로 UTC 기준 하루에 단 하나의 호출자만 진행되며, 쓰기 불가능한 디렉토리는 프로세스당 한 번의 보고로 제한됩니다. 이벤트 이름, 속성 및 ID 파생 방식은 변경되지 않았으며, 이미 스탬프가 찍힌 날은 아무것도 기록하지 않고 반환됩니다. ([#8519](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8519))

entries.original: The memory pressure advisory counts the text your model is actually shown again. A recent change estimated from the sizes git stored, which reads low for any `system/` file holding invalid UTF-8 and reported no pressure at all when the repository could not be read; both are restored, and the estimate is still computed once per commit rather than once per prompt.
entries.translated: 메모리 압박 권고 기능이 모델에 실제로 표시되는 텍스트를 다시 계산합니다. 최근 변경 사항에서 git에 저장된 크기를 기준으로 추정했으나, 이는 유효하지 않은 UTF-8이 포함된 `system/` 파일의 크기를 낮게 측정하거나 저장소를 읽을 수 없을 때 압박을 전혀 보고하지 않는 문제가 있었습니다. 이 두 가지를 모두 복구했으며, 추정치는 여전히 프롬프트당 한 번이 아닌 커밋당 한 번 계산됩니다.

entries.original: `omo doctor` sees your running sessions again. It recognised engines by one spelling of their command line, and the launcher stopped producing that spelling when it moved onto the engine's pre-linked bundle, so the stale-session report and its reap command had been looking at an empty list on current installs.

The reminder that your soul files changed no longer re-reads the whole memory history to find out. It asked git for every commit since the last notice that touched `system/`, which on an identity with thousands of commits costs most of a second on every prompt; it now reads a page and only looks further when that page is entirely memory-tool writes. The notice it produces is the same one.

entries.original: Every prompt in a directory with a memory identity re-read the same files from git. The memory pressure advisory listed the repository tree and read each `system/*.md` blob again on every turn, and the save reminder asked git for the entire commit history and searched it here. Both answers only change when the memory repository gains a commit, so both are now derived once per commit: five fewer git processes per prompt, and a megabyte of commit history that no longer crosses the process boundary on a repository with three thousand commits. What the model receives is unchanged.
